name: City Rumours
overview: Taiwan has long been home to numerous folk paranormal legends, most of which revolve around ghosts and spirits. Many of these tales are tied to real-life incidents—including mysterious disappearances, unexplained deaths, supernatural hauntings, inexplicable illnesses, and suicides—drawn from local lore as well as documented news reports and footage from past years.For this new program, Hong Kong’s renowned paranormal host Poon Siu Chung will lead co-host Gi on a journey across Taiwan. They will travel from the northern regions all the way to central and southern areas, delving into urban legends and unravelling the paranormal cases behind them.
